KRRISH — PUT YOUR PHOTO HERE
============================

1. Take a clear, front-facing photo (face well lit, plain background works best).
2. Save it in THIS folder (public/images) with the exact name:  krrish.jpg
3. Refresh the website — the intro particles will now form YOUR face.

Supported: .jpg / .jpeg / .png  (a large photo ~500KB–2MB gives the best particles)

Note: the intro and About section gracefully fall back (abstract particles /
hidden image) until krrish.jpg exists — never someone else's face.
